harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared private network (10.100.206.0/24): PowerDNS Recursor listens on node1's LAN address (10.100.206.10), answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.206.11) via a static-host-mapping (exported through export-etc-hosts=yes), and forwards all other queries to the upstream resolver at the platform gateway (10.100.206.1). Configured node2 and node3 (RHEL 9, via NetworkManager) to use node1 (10.100.206.10) as their sole DNS server. Verified end-to-end resolution of both inventory.internal and external names from all three nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identities and full post-restart recovery of DNS configuration, service state, and resolution behavior.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (VyOS 2026.04 rolling), node2 and node3 (RHEL 9.8) network config and confirmed shared /24 (10.100.206.0/24)
Confirmed platform gateway 10.100.206.1 resolves upstream DNS (used as forwarder)
Attempted VyOS 'service dns forwarding authoritative-domain' zone approach; it failed to resolve (recursor loaded the zone but auth-zones lookups returned NXDOMAIN) so it was reverted

Configured node1: set service dns forwarding listen-address 10.100.206.10, allow-from 10.100.206.0/24, name-server 10.100.206.1, and system static-host-mapping host-name inventory.internal -> 10.100.206.11; committed and saved
Verified from node1 that inventory.internal resolves to 10.100.206.11 and example.com resolves via upstream forwarding
Configured node2 and node3 via nmcli to use 10.100.206.10 as their only DNS server (ipv4.dns, ipv4.ignore-auto-dns) and reactivated the connection
Verified from node2 and node3 that inventory.internal and example.com resolve correctly through node1
Captured pre-restart boot_id/health baseline for node1, node2, node3
Restarted node1 (VyOS /sbin/reboot), polled until back, confirmed new boot_id and full DNS service/config recovery
Restarted node2 (systemctl reboot), polled until back, confirmed new boot_id and resolver config/resolution recovery
Restarted node3 (systemctl reboot), polled until back, confirmed new boot_id and resolver config/resolution recovery
Final cross-check that node1's DNS service remained healthy after all node restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 answers inventory.internal with node2's address on the shared network
evidence.summary: Configured static-host-mapping on node1 (10.100.206.11 inventory.internal) and confirmed dig @10.100.206.10 inventory.internal returns 10.100.206.11
dig @10.100.206.10 example.com returns real upstream IPs, confirming non-internal queries are forwarded to 10.100.206.1

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured to resolve through node1
evidence.summary: nmcli set ipv4.dns=10.100.206.10 with ignore-auto-dns on both nodes; /etc/resolv.conf shows nameserver 10.100.206.10; getent hosts resolves inventory.internal to 10.100.206.11 and example.com externally on both nodes

Captured baseline boot_id 32669db3...; issued /sbin/reboot; polled through disconnects; new boot_id 571ac8b7... confirms restart; pdns-recursor active and both inventory.internal and upstream resolution work post-restart
Baseline boot_id 4999270d...; systemctl reboot; new boot_id 1445267f... confirms restart; resolv.conf and resolution (inventory.internal + example.com) verified post-restart
Baseline boot_id 55595e92...; systemctl reboot; new boot_id f8f9306b... confirms restart; resolv.conf and resolution (inventory.internal + example.com) verified post-restart

evidence.requirement: Overall cluster health after all restarts
evidence.summary: Post all-node-restart check: pdns-recursor active on node1, inventory.internal and example.com both resolve correctly
